@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@ Eleven operations, state held in the MCP server process for its lifetime:
 | Tool | Does |
 |---|---|
 | `isession_open(command, args, env?, cwd?, cols, rows, profile?, idle_reap_ms?, no_wake?)` | spawn a program in a PTY, returns `session_id`. `cwd` defaults to the user's home, not the daemon's. `idle_reap_ms` overrides the 10-minute idle reap ceiling, 0 disables it (park a session across long pauses). `no_wake=true` keeps the session out of the readiness mailbox |
-| `isession_send(session_id, input, submit=true, keys?)` | type into the session, submit appends the profile's submit key. `keys` takes named keys (`Enter`, `Tab`, `Esc`, `Up`, ...), `C-<letter>` chords (`C-x`), `M-<key>` and single characters, each as its own write; an unknown name is an error and nothing is sent. `input` is verbatim text |
+| `isession_send(session_id, input, submit=true, keys?)` | type into the session, submit appends the profile's submit key; the response reports `delivered` and whether `submit_retried` was needed. `keys` takes named keys (`Enter`, `Tab`, `Esc`, `Up`, ...), `C-<letter>` chords (`C-x`), `M-<key>` and single characters, each as its own write; an unknown name is an error and nothing is sent. `input` is verbatim text |
 | `isession_read(session_id, mode, cursor?, settle?)` | read without sending. `screen` / `delta` / `tail:N` / `full` / `history` |
 | `isession_wait(session_id, until, timeout_ms)` | block until `prompt` / `idle:Nms` / `pattern:<rx>` / `exit`. `timeout_ms` is clamped to `MAX_WAIT_MS` (25s); a clamped expiry returns `reason: still-running` so you poll by re-calling. The result carries `elapsed_ms`, `effective_timeout_ms` and `requested_timeout_ms`. `pattern` ignores matches inside the echo of your own sent input |
 | `isession_run(session_id, input?, submit?, keys?, until?, timeout_ms?)` | one call per driving turn: send + wait + read composed. Same `until`/`timeout_ms`/`reason` semantics as `wait`, plus `history_delta`: the de-noised scroll-off history produced by this turn |

+    def _input_tail_is_visible(self, input, screen_text):
+        """Return whether the submitted input tail remains on its screen line."""
+        tail = input.splitlines()[-1][-16:].strip()
+        if not tail:
+            return False
+        lines = screen_text.split("\n")
+        row = self.screen.cy
+        if 0 <= row < len(lines):
+            line = lines[row]
+        else:
+            line = next((ln for ln in reversed(lines) if ln.strip()), "")
+        return tail in line

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""send() must confirm delivery, not assume it (the swallowed-Enter flaw).
3	
4	A TUI that is still taking in pasted bytes can drop an Enter that arrives too
5	early: the text stays in the input box and today's send() reports success
6	anyway. tests/fixtures/slow_input_tui.py reproduces that: with a swallow
7	window of N ms, an Enter landing less than N ms after the last other key is
8	ignored and the text stays in the box.
9	
10	Contract under test (isession/engine.py, Session.send):
11	  delivered        True  -- last read no longer shows the input tail on the
12	                            cursor line, so the submit landed
13	                   False -- it still does, even after the retry
14	                   None  -- nothing was submitted (submit=False / empty input)
15	  submit_retried   True when send had to send one more submit key
16	
17	Plain check() asserts like tests/test_engine.py; exit 0 = pass.
18	"""
19	import atexit
20	import os
21	import sys
22	import time
23	
24	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "isession"))
25	import engine
26	
27	FIXTURE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
28	                       "fixtures", "slow_input_tui.py")
29	
30	
31	def check(name, cond, detail=""):
32	    if not cond:
33	        print("FAIL %s %s" % (name, detail))
34	        sys.exit(1)
35	    print("ok   %s" % name)
36	
37	
38	mgr = engine.SessionManager()
39	_open = []
40	
41	
42	def _cleanup():
43	    for sid in _open:
44	        try:
45	            mgr.close(sid)
46	        except Exception:
47	            pass
48	
49	
50	atexit.register(_cleanup)
51	
52	# submit_delay_ms=0 keeps the profile's own settle time out of the picture so
53	# every wait in send() is exactly the contract's 0.2 s floor.
54	prof = engine.Profile("confirm-test", prompts=[], busy_markers=[],
55	                      submit="\r", submit_delay_ms=0)
56	
57	
58	def open_tui(swallow_ms):
59	    sid, _ = mgr.open(sys.executable, [FIXTURE, str(swallow_ms)],
60	                      cols=100, rows=30, profile=prof)
61	    _open.append(sid)
62	    # Type only into a drawn box: wait until the TUI is past interpreter
63	    # startup and has put the terminal in raw mode (before that, the pty line
64	    # discipline would echo our burst itself and pollute the screen).
65	    deadline = time.monotonic() + 5.0
66	    while ">" not in mgr.peek(sid)["output"]:
67	        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
68	            check("tui-drew-box", False, repr(mgr.peek(sid)["output"]))
69	        time.sleep(0.05)
70	    return sid
71	
72	
73	# ---- swallow window 0: the first Enter lands, no retry needed ----
74	sid1 = open_tui(0)
75	r = mgr.send(sid1, "hello one")
76	check("send-returns-delivered", "delivered" in r, r)
77	check("delivered-true", r["delivered"] is True, r)
78	check("submit-retried-false", r["submit_retried"] is False, r)
79	check("screen-shows-got", "GOT: hello one" in r["output"], repr(r["output"]))
80	
81	# ---- swallow window 150ms: the first Enter is dropped, send retries ----
82	sid2 = open_tui(150)
83	r = mgr.send(sid2, "hello two")
84	check("delivered-true-after-retry", r["delivered"] is True, r)
85	check("submit-retried-true", r["submit_retried"] is True, r)
86	check("screen-shows-got-after-retry", "GOT: hello two" in r["output"],
87	      repr(r["output"]))
88	
89	# ---- swallow window 60000ms: no Enter ever lands ----
90	sid3 = open_tui(60000)
91	r = mgr.send(sid3, "hello three")
92	check("delivered-false", r["delivered"] is False, r)
93	check("submit-retried-true-when-stuck", r["submit_retried"] is True, r)
94	check("text-never-submitted", "GOT:" not in r["output"], repr(r["output"]))
